# OpenAI Co-Founders: Current Affiliations Report
**As of September 19, 2026**

## The Complete Founding Team
OpenAI was founded in December 2015 as a nonprofit. According to Wikipedia and multiple sources, the company had **11 co-founders** (founding employees/scientists):

1. Elon Musk
2. Sam Altman
3. Ilya Sutskever
4. Greg Brockman
5. Trevor Blackwell
6. Vicki Cheung
7. Andrej Karpathy
8. Durk Kingma
9. John Schulman
10. Pamela Vagata
11. Wojciech Zaremba

*(Note: Musk and Altman served as co-chairs. Some early investors—Reid Hoffman, Jessica Livingston, Peter Thiel, AWS, Infosys—are sometimes mentioned but were funders, not co-founders.)*

---

## Current Affiliations (One by One)

### 1. Sam Altman — **Still at OpenAI**
- **CEO of OpenAI** (since 2019; survived Nov 2023 ouster/reinstatement). Remains the public face of the company into 2026.
- Also **Chairman of Helion Energy** (nuclear fusion). Stepped down as chairman of Oklo Inc. in April 2025 to avoid conflicts.

### 2. Elon Musk — **Left OpenAI; runs rival xAI**
- Left OpenAI's board in **2018**. Founded **xAI** in 2023 (maker of Grok), which **became a subsidiary of SpaceX in 2026**.
- **CEO/product architect of Tesla**; **founder, CEO and chief engineer of SpaceX**; **founder and CTO of X Corp.** (owner of X/Twitter); co-founder of **Neuralink** and **The Boring Company**; President of the **Musk Foundation**.
- Served as Senior Advisor to the President / de facto head of DOGE (Jan–May 2025); left the administration.
- Lost the *Musk v. Altman* lawsuit against OpenAI in May 2026 (jury found it barred by statute of limitations).

### 3. Ilya Sutskever — **Left OpenAI; leads Safe Superintelligence Inc.**
- Left OpenAI in May 2024. Co-founded **Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI)** in June 2024 with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy.
- **CEO of SSI** (became CEO in July 2025 after Gross left for Meta). SSI was valued at ~$32B and received a $5B Nvidia investment in July 2026.
- Holds a ~$7B OpenAI stake (revealed in 2026 trial testimony); net worth estimated ~$13.8B.

### 4. Greg Brockman — **Still at OpenAI**
- **Co-founder, President, and CEO of Applications at OpenAI** (took a sabbatical Aug–Nov 2024, then returned).
- Estimated net worth ~$25.5B (July 2026), mostly from his OpenAI stake.

### 5. Trevor Blackwell — **Y Combinator / robotics; based in England**
- **Co-founder and partner at Y Combinator** (was a YC partner until 2020); founder and former CEO of **Anybots** (robotics).
- Worked at OpenAI as a founding researcher until 2017.
- Wikipedia notes he is now **based in England**.

### 6. Vicki Cheung — **Co-founder of Gantry**
- Was OpenAI's **head of infrastructure** (2015–2018). Left for **Lyft** (software engineer, 2018–2020).
- **Co-founded Gantry** in 2020 with fellow early OpenAI employee Josh Tobin — a startup helping companies analyze/improve ML model performance. (**Current affiliation: Gantry**.)
- Previously a founding engineer at Duolingo.

### 7. Andrej Karpathy — **Joined Anthropic (2026)**
- Had two stints at OpenAI (2015–2017, 2023–2024) and was Tesla's Director of AI (2017–2022).
- Founded **Eureka Labs** (AI education company) in 2024.
- **Joined Anthropic in May 2026** as part of the pretraining research team — his current primary affiliation.

### 8. Durk Kingma — **Research scientist at Anthropic**
- Invented the variational autoencoder (VAE) and the Adam optimizer.
- Left OpenAI (led Algorithms team) in 2018 for Google Brain / Google DeepMind (generative models).
- **Joined Anthropic in October 2024** as a research scientist — his current affiliation.

### 9. John Schulman — **Chief Scientist at Thinking Machines Lab**
- OpenAI co-founder and "architect of ChatGPT" (led reinforcement learning team). Left OpenAI in August 2024 for **Anthropic** (AI alignment).
- Left Anthropic in February 2025 to join **Thinking Machines Lab** (Mira Murati's startup), where he is **Chief Scientist** — his current affiliation.

### 10. Pamela Vagata — **Founder of Pebblebed (VC)**
- One of two women on the founding team. Previously at Microsoft and Facebook (AI research engineer); joined **Stripe** in 2016 as an AI tech lead.
- **Founded Pebblebed in 2021**, a venture capital firm specializing in early-stage AI investments — her current affiliation.

### 11. Wojciech Zaremba — **Still at OpenAI**
- Co-founder (2016–present). Initially led OpenAI's robotics work (Rubik's Cube-solving robotic arm).
- Now **leads teams working on OpenAI's GPT models, GitHub Copilot, and Codex** — still with OpenAI.

---

## Summary Table

| Co-founder | Current Primary Affiliation (Sept 2026) | Status vs. OpenAI |
|---|---|---|
| Sam Altman | OpenAI — CEO | Still there |
| Elon Musk | Tesla (CEO), SpaceX (CEO), xAI (founder/CEO, now SpaceX subsidiary), X Corp. | Left 2018 |
| Ilya Sutskever | Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) — CEO/founder | Left 2024 |
| Greg Brockman | OpenAI — President & CEO of Applications | Still there |
| Trevor Blackwell | Y Combinator (co-founder/partner); Anybots; based in England | Left 2017 |
| Vicki Cheung | Gantry — co-founder | Left 2018 |
| Andrej Karpathy | Anthropic — pretraining research (joined May 2026); Eureka Labs founder | Left 2024 |
| Durk Kingma | Anthropic — research scientist | Left 2018 |
| John Schulman | Thinking Machines Lab — Chief Scientist | Left 2024 |
| Pamela Vagata | Pebblebed — founder (AI venture capital) | Left 2016 |
| Wojciech Zaremba | OpenAI — GPT/Copilot/Codex teams | Still there |

**Key takeaway:** Only **three** of the original 11 co-founders remain at OpenAI today — **Sam Altman, Greg Brockman, and Wojciech Zaremba**. The rest have dispersed across the AI industry and tech world, with a notable cluster now at **Anthropic** (Karpathy, Kingma), the rival AI lab founded by ex-OpenAI staff.

*Note: The latest 2026 affiliation details for Vicki Cheung, Pamela Vagata, and Trevor Blackwell are based on the most recent available records (2024–2025 reporting); verification of any very recent changes for these three was limited by search availability.*
